title: B · Clinical clarity: choose the working layout
question: The teal design is fixed. Keep the original side-by-side layout, or choose one of these two structural alternatives.

options.label: 1 · Original split review
options.thesis: Horizontal document strip, equal summary and source panes.
options.viewport: The B mockup you chose, with experiments below.
options.risk: Document list becomes a horizontal strip as it grows.

options.label: 2 · Wide evidence review
options.thesis: Top navigation frees space for a document index and two reading panes.
options.viewport: Document index, summary, and source remain visible together.
options.risk: Three columns need stacking on smaller screens.

options.label: 3 · Guided review
options.thesis: A visible three-stage workflow with source checking beside a wider summary.
options.viewport: Upload, check text, review summary; source area left and draft right.
options.risk: Workflow guidance takes more vertical space.
